description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND +10%/20%/30%/40%/50% (25s)] if 1/2/3/4/5+ party members are alive, [Conditional Attach Element From Party], [Damage Cap +10000], [Historical Covenant Follow-Up], [Nameless Historia Ability Tracker], [Nameless Historia Level] and [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dr. Mog]

description.name: Conditional Attach Element From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark]/[Attach Poison] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Historical Covenant Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Historical Covenant after using two abilities

description.name: Nameless Historia Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Nameless Historia level by 1 after using 6 or 10 abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dr. Mog]

description.name: Nameless Historia Level
description.text: Keeps track of Nameless Historia level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dr. Mog]

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dr. Mog
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Nameless Historia (0~2), removed after using Nameless Historia two times
